generation.forced_text:
I remember taking walks around town every Sunday morning before college to start my day on my old bicycle; there were few other things more enjoyable for this young adult than riding along quiet back roads. But I was surprised when on Sunday, a familiar path took some twists that left a deep and unexpected memory on the road to adulthood.
My usual morning bike trip involved taking an older road past a quaint church with stained-glass window. The windows reflected light on an older brick wall, a scene familiar from many trips to town, and always a nice start as it was usually the warm light before dawn.
I remember one Sunday being surprised at this scene when a detail caught me off-bread and altered that perspective, as I realized I was riding the bike on what used not so very recently been someone I loved’s childhood home and garden; now, a quiet path
